name: @avidia/simulation
description: Stateful virtual-patient simulation engine (M11): deterministic case-rule interpreter (TypeScript mirror of the SQL implementation), explicit patient state, controlled action catalog, structured events, step-based simulation time, clinical-judgment scoring, hidden-finding redaction, M8 evidence normalization, and strict case-definition validation. Pure functions only — no database access, no AI calls, no node built-ins — safe for the web bundle.
